key_insight: Relaxed λ-(STF)₂GaCl₄ has a narrower frontier bandwidth than its BETS counterpart while retaining substantial dimerization, and unrelaxed-structure Wannier models reveal selectively weakened electronic connectivity.
engineering_relevance: Structure-sensitive bandwidths and transfer integrals help parameterize low-energy models of molecular conductors.
method: Use DFT to compare BETS and STF electronic structures.
Compare DFT-selected and XRD-refined STF models before and after fixed-lattice relaxation.
Construct two maximally localized Wannier functions per selected unrelaxed structure for the upper frontier bands.
evidence_signal: The STF structural models yield similar near-Fermi electronic structures after relaxation; unrelaxed Wannier models give total spreads of 36.708 Å² for BETS and 37.578 Å² for STF, with t_d1 decreasing from 51 to 6.5 meV.
watch_item: The reported Wannier transfer integrals describe selected unrelaxed structures and should not be assumed to represent the relaxed structures.
paper_title: Wannier-Based Low-Energy Electronic Structure Analysis of $λ$-(STF)$_2$GaCl$_4$
